name: stale_aggregate
description: In the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber/ship endpoint, when a lineitem's l_shipdate is updated, the parent orders.o_latest_shipdate is not recalculated from the current lineitem rows. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey endpoint then serves this potentially stale o_latest_shipdate value without recomputing it from the source-of-truth lineitem records.
